description: This class provides utility methods to read and write ConfigurationImage objects to and from files, including handling the file headers and content serialization.

classes.name: ConfigurationImageFile
classes.description: Utility class with static methods for reading and writing ConfigurationImage objects from/to files, handling headers and content serialization.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads a ConfigurationImage object from a file specified by filename.

methods.name: readFromStream
methods.description: Reads a ConfigurationImage object from a FileInputStream, verifying the header.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Serializes a ConfigurationImage object into a byte array including the header.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Saves a ConfigurationImage object to a file specified by filename.
